latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Universal multi-agent workflow orchestration with Claude Code Agent Teams.

- Supports orchestration of 5-agent teams (1 lead, 4 specialized teammates) for any domain.
- Provides flexible pipeline patterns: sequential, parallel-merge, iterative-review, and fan-out-fan-in.
- Includes customizable role cards for domain-specific workflow specialization.
- Enforces a strict, domain-agnostic 6-step coordination protocol from scope confirmation to final synthesis.
- Defines clear lead discipline rules and failure handling procedures for robust team collaboration.
